chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a bold, bright opening call that announces the open road: a rising fanfare on the lead over a drum pickup, landing on a held chord that springs straight into the walking theme}
positive_styles: plucked harp arpeggios like chiming buoys
bouncy synth bass rocking root and fifth
light brushy snare and soft kick like lapping foam
adventurous walking theme for the first route of a journey
